rationale: The trial randomized 80 students. An independent extraction gives 40 assigned fennel and 38 controls analyzed. Original Table 1 reports self-rated menstrual weakness 6.65 to 2.88 versus 6.39 flat (p=.001). The abstract gives a differing control value. No placebo, toasted seed or Parkinson fatigue endpoint.

Original randomized trial, 30 assigned hydrolysate and 10 maltodextrin. Overall SPPB and chair performance favored active, with no separate standing-balance estimate. The intervention is a rice protein hydrolysate.

The rotenone-rat original abstract reports favorable general ambulation and qualitative pole-time directions in germinated rice groups. Numeric standalone pole estimates, a verified cooking step and a separately assessed postural reflex are unavailable.

The original Figure 2A favors cooked ground brown rice during concurrent iron exposure on a timed fly climbing measure. That design replaces part of the feed and tests co-exposure. Independence from related program results and boundary to clinical postural instability remain unresolved.

The associated original Figure 2 favors brown rice plus iron versus iron alone. No marked brown versus white comparison, verified cooking or independent exact cohort. The figure and methods differ in arm counts, test distance and comparator labels. The signed observation concerns locomotion only.
